basic_information.function: the function of the proposed system/architecture/pipeline, including its input and output description
basic_information.application_scenarios: the application scenarios provided/proposed by the study
basic_information.arch_exist: the number of the figure (e.g., Figure 1)
basic_information.caption: the caption of the figure

workflows.flow_id: the identifier of the workflow, unique within the article
workflows.flow_type: the type of workflow, use 'MAIN' for main workflow, use 'SUPPORT' for supporting workflow
workflows.input: the input of the workflow, including the input type and description, e.g., user query (text), speech (audio)
workflows.output: the output of the workflow, including the output type and description, e.g., voice response (audio),
module_seq: the internal modules that constitute the workflow
dependencies: the supporting workflow id of dependence

modules.mod_id: the identifier of the module (use id in mermaid code)
modules.role: the role of the module, STRICTLY select from the Role Taxonomy. DO NOT INVENT NEW ROLES.
modules.function_description: a detailed description of the module's function, including the input and output description
modules.technical_details: a detailed description of the module's key technical and implementation details.
modules.mermaid_def: the code of the module in mermaid syntax, only include the internal structure, without the connections leading to the outside.
subnodes: the subnodes included in the module

incoming.source_mod: the identifier of the incoming module (in mermaid code)
incoming.source_mod_internal_node: the identifier of the incoming subnode in the source module (use 'Unknown' if it is not clear)
incoming.connects_to_internal_node: the specific node in the subgraph the incoming node is connected to. Use 'NONE' if the incoming node is not connected to any internal node.
incoming.edge_label: the label of the incoming data, use 'NONE' if no label

outgoing.target_mod: the identifier of the outgoing module (in mermaid code)
outgoing.target_mod_internal_node: the identifier of the outgoing subnode in the target module (use 'Unknown' if it is not clear)
outgoing.originates_from_internal_node: the specific node in the subgraph the outgoing node is originated from. Use 'NONE' if the outgoing node is not originated from any internal node.
outgoing.edge_label: the label of the outgoing data, use 'NONE' if no label

full_code: the full code of the diagram in mermaid syntax
